relevance_note: The paper describes four named homozygotes for an LCAT missense mutation with fish-eye disease: "three additional homozygotes, two sisters (II-13 and II-15) and a brother (II-3) of the index patient".
method_note: Read the full paper; per-patient cells of Tables II and III were cut from the Markdown lines by a short script and checked by eye against the tables. Scope: 4 homozygous probands (II-3, II-11, II-13, II-15) get rows. The 34 heterozygous relatives are described only as group counts and means (22 male, 12 female; Tables I-III) with no individual-level detail or labels in the text (only in the Fig. 1 pedigree image), so they get no rows; the deceased, untested parents ("died at ages 86 and 76") are neither tested nor stated affected and get no rows. Labels: tables print OCR-garbled labels ("11-3", "11-13", "11-15", "II-II"); the text form II-x is used. All four are called probands in the paper ("All four probands, i.e., II3, II-11..."); II-11 is the index patient. Ages: "Two brothers, 64 and 58 yr of age" assigned via "elder brother (II-3)"/"younger brother (II-11)"; the sisters' ages (57 and 55) cannot be assigned and are not reported. CAD onset 54 (II-3) and 43 (II-11) taken from "(II-3 and II-11) ... at ages 54 and 43", consistent with II-3's bypass at 54 and II-11's diagnosis 2 yr after age 41; note that another sentence says "manifest at ages 43 and 54, respectively" without names. Variant: printed as gene-sequence numbering "A 2205-G" (McLean et al. sequence), no c./p. HGVS, no transcript; protein recorded as "N131D". Contradictions in the paper: the abstract says "Asp 131 Asn (N131D)" while the text says asparagine->aspartic acid (Asn131Asp); the Methods write "G2205-A; N131D". Contradiction for II-11: Results say "a low normal CER (Table I)" while later text says CER was "substantially reduced (II-11 and II-15...)"; both rows emitted (no checklist item affected). Also II-3's LDL-cholesterol in Table II is 1.5 mmol/liter while the text calls LDL normal in all four; the text was followed. Normal kidney function and absence of proteinuria (group statements naming the four homozygotes) excluded CKD/renal failure and proteinuria; nephrotic syndrome left not reported. Normal LDL-cholesterol with elevated apo B recorded as low LDL/apo B excluded (D-27). II-15 "high normal TG" -> hypertriglyceridemia excluded; FC increased "in all probands... except for subject II-15" -> excluded for II-15. Possible prior report: reference 48 (Kastelein 1992, fish-eye disease in a family of Dutch descent) is cited, but the paper does not state that these patients were described there, so cites_prior_report is null. Several Markdown passages are OCR-garbled (e.g., in vitro results) and were not quoted where unreadable.
